name: code2graph-app
description: Code2Graph — PlantUML, Mermaid, GraphML, WireMark, D2, and Structurizr diagram editor. MCP returns source and a rendered image. Source-available under the Prosperity Public License 3.0.0.
author: Sergey Frolov <admin@code2graph.ru>

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:api & npm run dev
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs && node scripts/copy-c4-lib.mjs && node scripts/copy-archimate-lib.mjs && node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs
scripts.build:deploy: npm run prebuild && vite build && node scripts/build-single-html.mjs
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/mcp run typecheck
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix packages/mcp run test
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/copy-vendor.mjs && node scripts/copy-c4-lib.mjs && node scripts/copy-archimate-lib.mjs && node scripts/generate-pwa-icons.mjs
